what: Split the title text into two layers, top half and bottom half (4px gap in the middle). Each layer jitters at random x ±13, y ±4px, tilt ±10° (phone ±6, ±1, ±4) for .09s, jumps once more at .15 transparency for .075s, then snaps into place over .3s power4.out — each letter .09s later. Plays once when it reaches 80% of the screen.

options.scale: Length multiplier — original 1.5 (bounce .06×multiplier etc.). At 1 it is faster
options.split: Distance to split the halves up and down (px), default 4
